text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While strolling through the academy grounds,
I spotted a boisterous group of students having a lively time.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, and so get this~!!
The retriever at the dog cafe was, like,
totally clinging to me~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right then... an Umamusume came sprinting
toward us with terrifying speed.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Eep!? K-K-Kris S-senpai?!
W-What can I do for you……?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—A blunder.
I failed to fulfill—my errand.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
One of them dropped it a moment ago.
So I came to return it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I will deliver it once more.
With that――there is no problem.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Next time... I'll keep it peaceful.
choice_data_list: You really never get discouraged, do you?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—You have my thanks.
However—concern is unnecessary.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I do have people――who truly understand me.
――And that's enough.
